people.name: Manoah
people.line: Father of Samson, from the tribe of Dan.

translations.web: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “Please stay with us, that we may make a young goat ready for you.”
translations.bsb: “Please stay here,” Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, “and we will prepare a young goat for you.”
translations.kjv: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for
translations.asv: And Manoah said unto the angel of Jehovah, I pray thee, let us detain thee, that we may make ready a kid for thee.
